subject: MSA redline & Ariba attribute payload for PO automation
messages:
From: Sarah Connor <sarah.connor@acuhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MSA redline + Ariba attribute payload for PO automation

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, attaching the draft MSA with our standard procurement team's redlines (AcuHealth_MSA_Redline_v3.docx) and the attribute mapping export we use for Ariba (ariba_attribute_mapping_v1.csv). High-level asks from our side:
- Can Redwood accept our proposed data retention language in Section 7? We need 7 years for auditability.
- We include an MFA requirement for API keys in Section 3.2 — this may impact private deployment customers; please flag any conflicts.
- For PO automation we require the following fields be present in the PO payload from Redwood: PO Number, PO Line Number, GL Code, Tax Jurisdiction, Supplier Remit To.

Next steps we propose: legal redline review by you/your counsel, then a short alignment call (30 min) to agree on core positions and a mutually-agreed MAP for portal enrollment and test PO. Can you confirm your legal lead and a tentative timeline?

Thanks,
Sarah Connor
Director, Strategic Sourcing
AcuHealth

Attachments: AcuHealth_MSA_Redline_v3.docx (docx), ariba_attribute_mapping_v1.csv (csv)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Connor <sarah.connor@acuhealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-29T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA redline + Ariba attribute payload for PO automation

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for sending these over and for the call. I looped in Markus (ops) and Kimberly from legal to start the review. Quick acknowledgement and a few clarifying notes from our side:

1) Data retention (Section 7): Our standard hosted offering retains transactional telemetry for 2 years by default; we can support 7-year archival for Compliance/Private deployments but will need this scoped in the Order Form (cost + storage).
2) MFA for API keys: we enforce scoped API keys and recommend integrating with our customer-managed SSO/KMS for private deployments. For Hosted customers, we can add IP allowlist + rotating keys — Kimberly, please advise if the proposed language is blocker.
3) PO payload fields: We can map the five fields you listed. A couple of practical notes: GL Code mapping is free-text on some ERPs; we recommend sending a sample PO and one test invoice during onboarding to validate mapping rules.

Kimberly — can you take point on legal positions (liability cap, indemnity, data clauses) and produce a short comment summary we can share back to AcuHealth? Ideally by end of day tomorrow. Markus — can you prepare a quick checklist for the portal enrollment (SFTP/EDI options, test PO window, attribute sync cadence)? I propose a 30-minute alignment call on Friday 7/30; Sarah, does that work?

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

Attachments: (none)

On 2027-07-29 09:12, Sarah Connor wrote: (see above)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Connor <sarah.connor@acuhealth.com>
Date: 2027-07-29T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA redline + Ariba attribute payload for PO automation — legal summary\n
Hannah / Markus / Sarah —

I reviewed AcuHealth_MSA_Redline_v3.docx and have the following high-level positions (summary attached: legal_comments_summary.pdf):

- Liability cap: AcuHealth's proposed unlimited liability for certain indirect claims is not acceptable. Our standard position is liability limited to fees paid in the prior 12 months; we can consider tilting to 24 months for strategic deals if approved by RevOps.
- Indemnity: Request that indemnity be mutual and tied to breach of IP/copyright; remove expansive third-party customer indemnities.
- Data retention & audit rights: Accept in principle but will require Order Form to enumerate retention windows and any archival cost. For SOC2 / audit evidence we will provide: SOC2 Type II attestation plus scoped audit logs on request under NDA.
- MFA / API controls: Recommend converting prescriptive MFA language to 'customer must follow industry best practices; Redwood will provide controls and integration options'.

Operational asks (to AcuHealth) re: Ariba mapping:
- Provide one representative sample PO (XML) and one sample invoice.
- Confirm whether GL Code is mandatory (some internal BU systems send it empty). If it is mandatory we need a fall-back mapping rule.

I can produce a redline with our counterpositions (tracked) and propose a short clause we can accept for Section 7 that references the Order Form for retention specifics. I'll get the redline back to the thread by 2027-07-30T11:00:00-07:00.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy — Redwood Inference

Attachments: legal_comments_summary.pdf

AcuHealth is generally comfortable with the approach you outlined (Order Form to capture retention windows/costs; mutual indemnity; liability cap discussion — 24 months sounds workable pending RevOps review). We'll send the sample PO/XML and invoice this afternoon (attaching test_po_sample.xml for your ingest test).

Friday 7/30 at 11:00 PT for a 30-minute alignment works for our team. Proposed MAP:

- Mon 8/2: Redwood sends tracked counter MSA redline and portal enrollment checklist
- Wed 8/4: AcuHealth provides signed Order Form (or feedback) + test PO live window

Looking forward to closing this quickly.

Best,
